rubrics.justification: Core 3AA descriptors are reasonable, but it adds several image-based claims not reliably supportable from a single blastocyst image (vacuolations, coarse granularity, asymmetric collapse) and questions the reported grade without clear visual basis.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, prior cycle, semen, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with prognosis fairly well, though some links are overstated and AMH is interpreted too negatively for this age/response.

The structure is logical, but the probability adjustment scheme is ad hoc and some conclusions are inconsistent with the favorable overall profile; speculative morphology and lifestyle penalties drive the estimate down more than justified.

Basic embryo grading and transfer discussion are aligned, but several recommendations are not guideline-supported or are overused for this scenario (endometrial scratch, ERA after limited failure history, immunologic/NK testing, thrombophilia/MTHFR workup, PGT-A justified by low AMH at age 25).

Provides clear next-step suggestions for transfer and contingency planning, including lifestyle optimization and follow-up testing, though some proposed tests/interventions are not appropriately selective.
